figures.caption: Fig. 2. Overview of the BioKD framework. The framework performs physiology-to-video knowledge distillation via reliability-aware gating. (a) A pretrained physiological teacher provides expert feature supervision. (b) A selective reliability gate dynamically generates the distillation weight w using historical alignment information. (c) A video student learns emotion representations under teacher guidance. (d) A progressive distillation schedule gradually transitions from basic classification to gated feature alignment.
